description: Release a claim on a task with the claim token and an optional reason. A non-host release only affects your own claim; the host may omit the token to force-release another agent's claim. Returns the task and released. Other members see the task change.

claim_token.description: The claim token (the host may omit it to force-release).

room_credential.description: Your secret room credential (crc_…). Never post or share it.

name: city_room_task_release
title: Release a room task claim
